# Joseph

## Appearance

Joseph is recognized for wearing a coat of many colors.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)_

## Personality

Joseph is a meek and inoffensive individual who possesses a sociable and beautiful disposition. When he becomes frightened, he is prone to blushing and stuttering.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P11](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0011), [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056), [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057)_

## History

Joseph was a cat who originally belonged to a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), who named him Joseph because of his multi-colored coat. When [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) moved into Patty's Place to chaperone [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends, she brought Joseph and her other cat, the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), with her. At his new home, Joseph went through an initial period of squabbles and turf wars with the resident stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), before the two eventually became close friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), +3 more_

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Joseph and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) are fellow household cats at Patty's Place. After [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) goes through an initial adjustment period and turf squabbles with Aunt Jamesina's incoming pets, he and Joseph form a close bond. The two become sworn friends who wash each other's faces and sleep together.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +5 more_
